roadmap.goal: A developer runs only the fast tier while editing and gets an answer in seconds on both stacks. Every test that boots a host, needs a container or calls a real system carries the one Integration category through a shared base class, a misplaced backend test fails the build, and CI runs exactly what it runs today.
roadmap.notes: Rigor profile thorough: pass model explicitly on every dispatch, the profile's agent_model for crafters and reviewer_model for reviewers. No production file changes in any slice (guarantee 1 of the delta). Mutation per slice: A N/A (package.json and docs); B N/A (a test helper, tests, workflow, shell, docs); C N/A (test files only); D N/A (test files only); E N/A (test files only); F N/A for Stryker, which mutates the product assembly (Test-Fast.ps1 is shell; the Python scripts carry their own unit tests). Push plan, each push waiting for the one before to end: push 1 slice A (no backend run); push 2 slice B with slice C's 14 live classes, THE ONE LIVE-SUITE PUSH, force-full with every connector; push 3 the scan move alone, the first plain run, judged against T0; push 4 the hosted commit, which waits for one green plain run with no difference from T0; push 5 slice D; push 6 slice E after its proof; push 7 slice F. Pushes 3 to 7 are plain, and before each the push's diff goes through path-classifier.sh with every connector answer false. No other push on trunk while push 2 runs, and no live run or Linear key use for an hour before it (T12's last push edits ci_frontend.yml and is a live run too). Lighthouse.Backend.Tests.csproj stays untouched. On a red push 2: grep TooManyRequests, wait the hour, re-run the failed job, never push. Full-size backend runs: ONE, in 05-04, and it never overlaps another backend or frontend run; every other step runs dotnet build and named test classes only, and no crafter runs an unfiltered or standard-filter dotnet test. Id lists come from CI's test-timings-backend CSV of plain runs. All proof commands use -c Release with no variable ending IntegrationTestToken set. A diff line is accepted only as a foreign commit's test file or a test this Story added, named in the delta. A conflict with trunk stops the step and reports; nothing is rebased. No nWave scenario tag in any test title, comment or file. The filter strings, guarantees, probe table, stop rules and closing list are in feature-delta.md, sections Wave: DISTILL. Step 03-03 carries the scan move that DESIGN placed in slice D (D-6512-23).
